newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Bankoa says Caja Vasca offer insufficient.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Bankoa says Caja Vasca offer insufficient.

text.p: Spain's Bankoa said that Caja Rural Vasca's 3,000 peseta a share buy offer was insufficient, the Stock Market Commission CNMV said.

In a mandatory disclosure with the CNMV, Bankoa said "The board, in a meeting on June 20, agreed that the offer price was insufficient... and did not value adequately the patrimony, current development and immediate outlook for the bank.
"The bank also notes its unhappiness with the way the offer was presented," Bankoa said in its statement to the CNMV.
But Bankoa has not asked Caja Vasca to withdraw its offer.
